# TelegramUI - React UI Kit for Telegram Mini Apps

A comprehensive React component library designed for building Telegram Mini Apps. This library provides platform-adaptive components that automatically adjust their appearance based on the platform (iOS or base).

## Installation

```bash
npm install @telegram-apps/telegram-ui
```

## Getting Started

Wrap your application with `AppRoot` component:

```tsx
import { AppRoot } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
import '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui/dist/styles.css';

function App() {
  return (
    <AppRoot>
      {/* Your app content */}
    </AppRoot>
  );
}
```

---

## Components Reference

### BLOCKS

#### Accordion
Container for collapsible content sections using Context API for state management.

```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| id | string | auto | Optional ID for accessibility (a11y) |
| expanded | boolean | required | Whether accordion is expanded |
| onChange | (expanded: boolean) => void | required | Callback when state changes |
| children | ReactNode | required | Accordion.Summary and Accordion.Content |

**Sub-components:**
- `Accordion.Summary` - Clickable header (extends CellProps)
- `Accordion.Content` - Collapsible content area

**Example:**
```tsx
<Accordion expanded={isOpen} onChange={setIsOpen}>
  <Accordion.Summary>Click to expand</Accordion.Summary>
  <Accordion.Content>Hidden content here</Accordion.Content>
</Accordion>
```

---

#### Avatar
Renders an image with avatar-specific styling, including optional acronym display and badge support.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props (extends ImageProps):**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| acronym | string | - | One or two letters as placeholder |
| size | 20 \| 24 \| 28 \| 40 \| 48 \| 96 | 40 | Avatar size in pixels |
| fallbackIcon | ReactNode | - | Icon displayed when image fails to load |
| src | string | - | Image source URL |

**Sub-components:**
- `Avatar.Badge` - Badge overlay (supports only type="number")

**Example:**
```tsx
<Avatar src="/user.jpg" size={48} acronym="JD">
  <Avatar.Badge type="number">5</Avatar.Badge>
</Avatar>
```

---

#### AvatarStack
Displays multiple avatars in a stacked layout.

```tsx
import { AvatarStack } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactElement<AvatarProps>[] | required | Array of Avatar components |

**Example:**
```tsx
<AvatarStack>
  <Avatar src="/user1.jpg" />
  <Avatar src="/user2.jpg" />
  <Avatar src="/user3.jpg" />
</AvatarStack>
```

---

#### Badge
Small numeric or dot indicator for notifications, statuses, or counts.

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| type | 'number' \| 'dot' | required | Visual style of the badge |
| mode | 'primary' \| 'critical' \| 'secondary' \| 'gray' \| 'white' | 'primary' | Color scheme |
| large | boolean | false | Increases size (only for type='number') |
| children | ReactNode | - | Badge content (for type='number') |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Badge type="number" mode="critical">99+</Badge>
<Badge type="dot" mode="primary" />
```

---

#### Banner
Prominent graphical element for branding, promotion, or announcements.

```tsx
import { Banner } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| type | 'section' \| 'inline' | - | Layout style |
| before | ReactNode | - | Left side content (icon/image) |
| callout | ReactNode | - | Content above main content |
| header | ReactNode | - | Main text/title |
| subheader | ReactNode | - | Additional info below header |
| description | ReactNode | - | Further details |
| background | ReactNode | - | Custom background component |
| onCloseIcon | MouseEventHandler | - | Close icon callback |
| children | ReactNode | - | Buttons or other content |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Banner
  header="Welcome!"
  subheader="Check out new features"
  description="We've added exciting updates"
  onCloseIcon={() => setVisible(false)}
>
  <Button size="s">Learn More</Button>
</Banner>
```

---

#### Blockquote
Stylized blockquote for quotations or special text.

```tsx
import { Blockquote } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| type | 'text' \| 'other' | 'text' | Content type |
| topRightIcon | ReactNode | Quote icon | Icon in top right corner |
| children | ReactNode | - | Blockquote content |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Blockquote>
  "The only way to do great work is to love what you do."
</Blockquote>
```

---

#### Button
Interactive button with customizable size, mode, and loading state.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| before | ReactNode | - | Component before text (icon) |
| after | ReactNode | - | Component after text (badge) |
| size | 's' \| 'm' \| 'l' | 'm' | Button size |
| stretched | boolean | false | Fill container width |
| mode | 'filled' \| 'bezeled' \| 'plain' \| 'gray' \| 'outline' \| 'white' | 'filled' | Visual style |
| loading | boolean | false | Show loading indicator |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable interactions |
| Component | ElementType | 'button' | Root element type |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Button mode="filled" size="l" before={<Icon24Add />}>
  Add Item
</Button>
<Button mode="outline" loading>Processing...</Button>
```

---

#### Card
Container for card-styled UI elements with context support.

```tsx
import { Card } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| type | 'plain' \| 'ambient' | 'plain' | Visual style |

**Sub-components:**
- `Card.Cell` - Cell component styled for card context (extends CellProps)
- `Card.Chip` - Chip component styled for card context (extends ChipProps)

**Example:**
```tsx
<Card type="ambient">
  <Card.Chip>Featured</Card.Chip>
  <Card.Cell subtitle="Description">Card Title</Card.Cell>
</Card>
```

---

#### Cell
Flexible container for list items, form fields, and more.

```tsx
import { Cell } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props (extends TappableProps):**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| subhead | ReactNode | - | Content above main content |
| children | ReactNode | - | Main header content |
| hint | ReactNode | - | Content alongside header |
| titleBadge | ReactElement<BadgeProps> | - | Badge next to header |
| subtitle | ReactNode | - | Content below header |
| description | ReactNode | - | Additional description |
| before | ReactNode | - | Left side content |
| after | ReactNode | - | Right side content |
| Component | ElementType | 'div' | Root element type |
| hovered | boolean | false | External hover state |
| multiline | boolean | false | Allow multiline content |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Cell
  before={<Avatar size={48} src="/user.jpg" />}
  subtitle="Online"
  after={<Badge type="dot" />}
>
  John Doe
</Cell>
```

---

#### ButtonCell
Interactive cell component with leading and trailing elements.

```tsx
import { ButtonCell } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| mode | 'default' \| 'destructive' | 'default' | Visual theme |
| before | ReactNode | - | Element before content |
| after | ReactNode | - | Element after content |
| Component | ElementType | 'button' | Root element type |
| children | ReactNode | - | Button content |

**Example:**
```tsx
<ButtonCell before={<Icon24Add />}>Add new item</ButtonCell>
<ButtonCell mode="destructive" before={<Icon24Delete />}>Delete</ButtonCell>
```

**Props:**

| subtitle | string | - | Text for type='text' |
| avatarStack | ReactElement<AvatarStackProps> | - | Avatar stack for type='avatarStack' |
| children | ReactNode | - | Main content |

```tsx

```

**Props:**

|------|------|---------|-------------|
| size | 's' \| 'm' \| 'l' | 'm' | Button size (20px, 24px, 28px icons) |
| mode | 'bezeled' \| 'plain' \| 'gray' \| 'outline' | 'bezeled' | Visual style |

**Example:**
```tsx
<IconButton mode="plain" size="m">
  <Icon24Settings />
</IconButton>
```

#### Image
Image component with fallback support and badge overlay.

```tsx
import { Image } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| size | 20 \| 24 \| 28 \| 40 \| 48 \| 96 | 40 | Image size in pixels |
| fallbackIcon | ReactNode | - | Icon when image fails to load |
| children | ReactNode | - | Overlay content |
| src | string | - | Image source URL |

**Sub-components:**
- `Image.Badge` - Badge overlay (supports only type="number")

**Example:**
```tsx
<Image src="/product.jpg" size={96}>
  <Image.Badge type="number">New</Image.Badge>
</Image>
```

#### InlineButtons
Container for inline button items.

```tsx
import { InlineButtons } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| mode | 'plain' \| 'bezeled' \| 'gray' | - | Styling mode for all items |
| children | ReactElement<InlineButtonsItemProps>[] | required | InlineButtons.Item components |

**Sub-components:**
- `InlineButtons.Item` - Individual inline button

**InlineButtons.Item Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| text | string | - | Button text |
| mode | 'plain' \| 'bezeled' \| 'gray' | 'plain' | Button style |
| children | ReactNode | - | Icon content |

**Example:**
```tsx
<InlineButtons mode="bezeled">
  <InlineButtons.Item text="Share"><Icon24Share /></InlineButtons.Item>
  <InlineButtons.Item text="Copy"><Icon24Copy /></InlineButtons.Item>
</InlineButtons>
```

#### Placeholder
Display placeholder with text, images, and actions.

```tsx
import { Placeholder } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactNode | - | Primary visual content |
| header | ReactNode | - | Title/header text |
| description | ReactNode | - | Descriptive text |
| action | ReactNode | - | Action element (button) |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Placeholder
  header="No items found"
  description="Try adjusting your search"
  action={<Button>Reset Filters</Button>}
>
  <img src="/empty.svg" />
</Placeholder>
```

---

#### Section
Organize content into sections with headers and footers.

```tsx
import { Section } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| header | ReactNode | - | Section header (string auto-wrapped) |
| footer | ReactNode | - | Section footer (string auto-wrapped) |

**Sub-components:**
- `Section.Header` - Custom header with `large` prop
- `Section.Footer` - Custom footer with `centered` prop

**Section.Header Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| large | boolean | false | Large title style |

**Section.Footer Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| centered | boolean | false | Center text |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Section header="Settings" footer="Manage your preferences">
  <Cell>Notifications</Cell>
  <Cell>Privacy</Cell>
</Section>

<Section header={<Section.Header large>Large Title</Section.Header>}>
  <Cell>Content</Cell>
</Section>
```

---

#### Steps
Visual indicator for multi-step processes.

```tsx
import { Steps } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| count | number | required | Total number of steps |
| progress | number | required | Completed steps (0-indexed, up to count) |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Steps count={5} progress={3} />
```

---

#### Timeline
Sequence of events in vertical or horizontal layout.

```tsx
import { Timeline } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| horizontal | boolean | false | Horizontal orientation |
| active | number | - | Index of active item |
| children | ReactElement<TimelineItemProps>[] | required | Timeline.Item components |

**Sub-components:**
- `Timeline.Item` - Individual timeline item

**Timeline.Item Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| mode | 'active' \| 'pre-active' | - | Item state (auto-set by parent) |
| horizontal | boolean | - | Horizontal mode (auto-set by parent) |
| header | string | - | Item header |
| children | ReactNode | - | Item description |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Timeline active={2}>
  <Timeline.Item header="Order Placed">Your order was received</Timeline.Item>
  <Timeline.Item header="Processing">Order is being prepared</Timeline.Item>
  <Timeline.Item header="Shipped">On the way</Timeline.Item>
  <Timeline.Item header="Delivered">Enjoy your purchase</Timeline.Item>
</Timeline>
```

#### Checkbox
Custom styled checkbox with optional indeterminate state.

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props (extends InputHTMLAttributes):**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| indeterminate | boolean | false | Show indeterminate icon |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable checkbox |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Cell after={<Checkbox checked={selected} onChange={handleChange} />}>
  Accept Terms
</Cell>
```

#### Chip
Compact element for inputs, attributes, or actions.

```tsx
import { Chip } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| mode | 'elevated' \| 'mono' \| 'outline' | 'elevated' | Visual style |
| before | ReactNode | - | Content before text |
| after | ReactNode | - | Content after text |
| Component | ElementType | 'div' | Root element type |
| children | ReactNode | - | Chip text content |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Chip mode="mono" before={<Icon16Check />}>Selected</Chip>
<Chip mode="outline" after={<Icon16Close />}>Tag</Chip>
```

#### ColorInput
Color picker input with hex value display.

```tsx
import { ColorInput } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props (extends FormPublicProps, InputHTMLAttributes):**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| header | ReactNode | - | Input header |
| before | ReactNode | - | Content before input |
| status | 'default' \| 'error' \| 'focused' | 'default' | Visual state |
| value | string | '#EFEFF4' | Color value |
| onChange | ChangeEventHandler | - | Change callback |

**Example:**
```tsx
<ColorInput
  header="Background Color"
  value={color}
  onChange={(e) => setColor(e.target.value)}
/>
```

|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | 'Attach file' | Button label text |

**Example:**
```tsx

  label="Upload Document"

/>
```


**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| status | 'default' \| 'error' \| 'focused' | 'default' | Visual state |
| header | ReactNode | - | Header content (base platform only) |
| before | ReactNode | - | Content before input |
| after | ReactNode | - | Content after input |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable state |

#### Input
Text input field with form integration.

```tsx
import { Input } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props (extends FormPublicProps, InputHTMLAttributes):**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| type | string | 'text' | Input type |
| header | ReactNode | - | Input header |
| before | ReactNode | - | Content before input |
| after | ReactNode | - | Content after input |
| status | 'default' \| 'error' \| 'focused' | 'default' | Visual state |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable input |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Input
  header="Email"
  type="email"
  placeholder="Enter your email"
  status={error ? 'error' : 'default'}
/>
```

#### Multiselect
Comprehensive multiselect input with dropdown, chips, and search.

```tsx
import { Multiselect } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| options | MultiselectOption[] | required | Available options |
| value | MultiselectOption[] | [] | Selected options |
| defaultValue | MultiselectOption[] | - | Default selected options |
| onChange | (value: MultiselectOption[]) => void | - | Selection change callback |
| inputValue | string | - | Controlled input value |
| onInputChange | (value: string) => void | - | Input change callback |
| filterFn | Function | - | Custom filter function |
| closeDropdownAfterSelect | boolean | false | Close dropdown on select |
| selectedBehavior | string | - | Selected item behavior |
| emptyText | string | - | Empty state text |
| creatable | boolean | false | Allow creating new options |
| renderChip | Function | - | Custom chip renderer |
| renderOption | Function | - | Custom option renderer |
| header | ReactNode | - | Input header |
| before | ReactNode | - | Content before input |
| status | 'default' \| 'error' \| 'focused' | 'default' | Visual state |

**MultiselectOption type:**
```ts
type MultiselectOption = {
  value: string | number;
  label: ReactElement | string | number;
  [index: string]: any;
};
```

**Example:**
```tsx
<Multiselect
  header="Select Tags"
  options={[
    { value: 1, label: 'React' },
    { value: 2, label: 'TypeScript' },
    { value: 3, label: 'CSS' },
  ]}
  value={selectedTags}
  onChange={setSelectedTags}
  creatable
/>
```

#### PinInput
PIN code input with virtual keypad.

```tsx
import { PinInput } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | 'Enter your pin' | Label above PIN cells |
| pinCount | number | 4 | Number of PIN digits (min 2) |
| value | number[] | [] | Current PIN values |
| onChange | (value: number[]) => void | - | PIN change callback |
| onBiometricAuth | () => void | - | Biometric auth callback |
| biometricType | 'faceid' \| 'fingerprint' | - | Biometric type to display |

**Example:**
```tsx
<PinInput
  label="Enter PIN"
  pinCount={6}
  value={pin}
  onChange={setPin}
  biometricType="fingerprint"
  onBiometricAuth={handleBiometric}
/>
```

#### Slider
Slider input for value or range selection.

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Single value props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| multiple | false | - | Single-thumb mode |
| value | number | - | Current value |
| defaultValue | number | - | Default value |
| onChange | (value: number, event) => void | - | Change callback |

**Range props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| multiple | true | - | Range mode |
| value | [number, number] | - | Current range |
| defaultValue | [number, number] | - | Default range |
| onChange | (value: [number, number], event) => void | - | Change callback |

**Common props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| min | number | 0 | Minimum value |
| max | number | 100 | Maximum value |
| step | number | 1 | Step value |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable slider |
| before | ReactNode | - | Content before slider |
| after | ReactNode | - | Content after slider |
| getAriaLabel | (index: number) => string | - | Dynamic aria-label |
| getAriaValueText | (value: number, index: number) => string | - | Custom aria-valuetext |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Slider value={volume} onChange={setVolume} min={0} max={100} />
<Slider multiple value={priceRange} onChange={setPriceRange} min={0} max={1000} />
```

### TYPOGRAPHY

#### Typography (Base)
Base typography component with customizable styling.

```tsx
import { Typography } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| weight | '1' \| '2' \| '3' | '3' | Font weight (1=bold, 2=semibold, 3=regular) |
| caps | boolean | false | Transform to uppercase |
| Component | ElementType | 'span' | Root element type |
| plain | boolean | true | Remove default margins |

| level | '1' \| '2' | '1' | Size level |

#### Skeleton
Loading placeholder component.

```tsx

```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| withoutAnimation | boolean | false | Disable shimmer animation |

```tsx
  <Cell>Content loads here</Cell>
```

---

#### Snackbar
Brief message at the bottom of the screen.

```tsx
import { Snackbar } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| before | ReactNode | - | Left side content |
| after | ReactNode | - | Right side content |
| children | ReactNode | - | Main message |
| description | ReactNode | - | Additional content below message |
| link | ReactElement<LinkProps> | - | Link component |
| duration | number | 4000 | Auto-dismiss duration (ms) |
| onClose | () => void | required | Close callback |

**Sub-components:**
- `Snackbar.Button` - Action button for snackbar

**Example:**
```tsx
{showSnackbar && (
  <Snackbar
    onClose={() => setShowSnackbar(false)}
    description="Your changes have been saved"
    after={<Snackbar.Button>Undo</Snackbar.Button>}
  >
    Success!
  </Snackbar>
)}
```

#### Breadcrumbs

```tsx
import { Breadcrumbs } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |

| divider | 'dot' \| 'slash' \| 'chevron' | 'dot' | Divider type |

**Sub-components:**
- `Breadcrumbs.Item` - Individual breadcrumb item

```tsx
<Breadcrumbs divider="chevron">

  <Breadcrumbs.Item>Products</Breadcrumbs.Item>

</Breadcrumbs>
```

---

#### Pagination
Full pagination controls with page numbers.

```tsx
import { Pagination } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| boundaryCount | number | - | Pages at start and end |
| count | number | - | Total pages |
| defaultPage | number | - | Default page (uncontrolled) |
| hideNextButton | boolean | false | Hide next button |
| hidePrevButton | boolean | false | Hide previous button |
| onChange | (event, page: number) => void | - | Page change callback |
| page | number | - | Current page (controlled) |
| siblingCount | number | - | Pages around current page |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable pagination |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Pagination
  count={10}
  page={currentPage}
  onChange={(_, page) => setCurrentPage(page)}
  siblingCount={1}
  boundaryCount={1}
/>
```

---

#### SegmentedControl
Toggle between views or filter content.

```tsx
import { SegmentedControl } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactElement<SegmentedControlItemProps>[] | required | SegmentedControl.Item components |

**Sub-components:**
- `SegmentedControl.Item` - Individual segment

**SegmentedControl.Item Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| selected | boolean | false | Whether item is selected |

**Example:**
```tsx
<SegmentedControl>
  <SegmentedControl.Item selected={tab === 'all'} onClick={() => setTab('all')}>
    All
  </SegmentedControl.Item>
  <SegmentedControl.Item selected={tab === 'active'} onClick={() => setTab('active')}>
    Active
  </SegmentedControl.Item>
</SegmentedControl>
```

#### Tabbar
Bottom navigation tab bar.

```tsx
import { Tabbar } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactElement<TabbarItemProps>[] | required | Tabbar.Item components |

**Sub-components:**
- `Tabbar.Item` - Individual tab bar item

**Tabbar.Item Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| selected | boolean | false | Whether tab is active |
| text | string | - | Tab text |
| children | ReactNode | - | Tab icon (28x28) |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Tabbar>
  <Tabbar.Item selected={tab === 'home'} text="Home" onClick={() => setTab('home')}>
    <Icon28Home />
  </Tabbar.Item>
  <Tabbar.Item selected={tab === 'search'} text="Search" onClick={() => setTab('search')}>
    <Icon28Search />
  </Tabbar.Item>
  <Tabbar.Item selected={tab === 'profile'} text="Profile" onClick={() => setTab('profile')}>
    <Icon28Profile />
  </Tabbar.Item>
</Tabbar>
```

### OVERLAYS

#### Modal
Modal dialog with drawer-style presentation.

```tsx
import { Modal } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| open | boolean | - | Display state |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | State change callback |
| header | ReactNode | - | Header component |
| overlayComponent | ReactNode | ModalOverlay | Custom overlay |
| trigger | ReactNode | - | Trigger element |
| nested | boolean | false | Enable nesting |
| closeThreshold | number | - | Swipe close threshold (0-1) |
| scrollLockTimeout | number | - | Scroll lock debounce (ms) |
| modal | boolean | - | Background interaction |
| preventScrollRestoration | boolean | - | Prevent scroll restore |
| snapPoints | (number \| string)[] | - | Snap points for positioning |
| dismissible | boolean | - | Allow dismissal |

**Sub-components:**
- `Modal.Header` - Modal header with before/after slots
- `Modal.Overlay` - Overlay backdrop
- `Modal.Close` - Close button

**Modal.Header Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| before | ReactNode | - | Left side content |
| after | ReactNode | - | Right side content |
| children | ReactNode | - | Header title (iOS only) |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Modal
  open={isOpen}
  onOpenChange={setIsOpen}
  header={<Modal.Header after={<Modal.Close />}>Title</Modal.Header>}
>
  <Placeholder header="Modal Content">
    <Button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}>Close</Button>
  </Placeholder>
</Modal>
```

---

#### Popper
Floating element with dynamic positioning.

```tsx
import { Popper } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| targetRef | RefObject<HTMLElement> \| VirtualElement | required | Target element reference |
| placement | 'auto' \| 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' \| etc. | 'auto' | Placement direction |
| sameWidth | boolean | - | Match target width |
| offsetByMainAxis | number | 8 | Main axis offset |
| offsetByCrossAxis | number | 0 | Cross axis offset |
| withArrow | boolean | true | Show arrow |
| arrowProps | FloatingArrowProps | - | Arrow configuration |
| ArrowIcon | ElementType | Default arrow | Custom arrow icon |
| Component | ElementType | 'div' | Root element type |
| autoUpdateOnTargetResize | boolean | false | Auto-update on resize |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Popper targetRef={buttonRef} placement="top">
  Popper content
</Popper>
```

---

#### Tooltip
Text labels on hover/focus/touch.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props (extends PopperProps):**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| mode | 'light' \| 'dark' | 'light' | Color theme |
| targetRef | RefObject<HTMLElement> | required | Target element |

**Example:**
```tsx
<Tooltip targetRef={buttonRef} mode="dark">
  Helpful tooltip text
</Tooltip>
```

### SERVICE

#### AppRoot
Root component for the application. Required wrapper for all TelegramUI components.

```tsx
import { AppRoot } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| platform | 'ios' \| 'base' | auto-detected | Application platform |
| appearance | 'light' \| 'dark' | auto-detected | Color scheme |
| portalContainer | RefObject | AppRoot container | Portal container override |

**Example:**
```tsx
<AppRoot platform="ios" appearance="dark">
  <App />
</AppRoot>
```

---

#### RootRenderer
Renders children into portal container.

```tsx
import { RootRenderer } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactNode | - | Content to render in portal |

---

```tsx
import { Tappable } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';
```

**Props:**
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| Component | ElementType | 'div' | Root element type |
| interactiveAnimation | 'opacity' \| 'background' | 'background' | Interaction style |
| readOnly | boolean | - | Disable interactions |

---

## Platform Detection

Components automatically adapt based on platform. Use the `usePlatform` hook for custom logic:

```tsx
import { usePlatform } from '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui';

function MyComponent() {
  const platform = usePlatform();
  // platform: 'ios' | 'base'
}
```

## Appearance

Components support light and dark modes. Use `AppRoot` appearance prop or let it auto-detect from Telegram:

```tsx
<AppRoot appearance="dark">
  <App />
</AppRoot>
```

## CSS Variables

The library uses CSS custom properties for theming. Import styles:

```tsx
import '@telegram-apps/telegram-ui/dist/styles.css';
```

---

## Summary

**Total Components:** 50+ main components
**Categories:**
- Blocks: 18 components (Accordion, Avatar, Badge, Banner, Button, Card, Cell, etc.)
- Form: 16 components (Checkbox, Chip, Input, Select, Slider, Switch, etc.)
- Typography: 7 components (Caption, Text, Subheadline, Headline, Title, LargeTitle)
- Feedback: 6 components (CircularProgress, Progress, Skeleton, Snackbar, Spinner, Spoiler)
- Navigation: 6 components (Breadcrumbs, Link, Pagination, SegmentedControl, TabsList)
- Layout: 2 components (FixedLayout, Tabbar)
- Overlays: 3 components (Modal, Popper, Tooltip)
- Service: 4 components (AppRoot, RootRenderer, Tappable, VisuallyHidden)
- Misc: 1 component (Divider)
